name: Centrico
lede: Centrico, an open-air Mexican restaurant from Patina Restaurant Group and Michelin-starred chef Carlos Gaytán, wraps its tables around a central bar under a complex timber ceiling. Double-mounted Platinum Gas heaters keep every table warm.
data: Open-air restaurant around a central bar
Platinum Smart-Heat® Gas, natural gas, two sizes

hero.caption: The bar under the circular timber pavilion, heaters on the beams. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: The heat plan published with the case study. Bromic-published image.
Platinum Gas angled on beam brackets. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: With custom wooden elements and greenery by architect Jorge Gracia, Centrico is open and airy, built around a central bar with tables wrapping the space, for outdoor dining all year.
The open-air design made a steady temperature hard to hold, and the ceiling was the main complexity: the heaters had to blend in, meet fire ratings per code and reach every table.

Ignisio Studios brought Bromic in for a design charrette. Platinum natural gas heaters in two sizes were ceiling-mounted with flexible mounting and double-mounted, so guests at every table are warm. Sister restaurant Paseo uses Platinum Gas too.

quote.text: Bromic provided the flexibility of how it was mounted into the ceiling.
